name: PLCC Dev Container
initializeCommand: test -d ../change-requests || git clone https://github.com/ourPLCC/change-requests ../change-requests; git -C ../change-requests config core.hooksPath .githooks
postCreateCommand: sudo chown vscode:vscode /home/vscode/.claude && npm i -g backlog.md@$(cat /workspaces/change-requests/.backlog-version) && git -C /workspaces/change-requests status >/dev/null && git -C ${containerWorkspaceFolder} status >/dev/null
postStartCommand: curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://get-ghcup.haskell.org | BOOTSTRAP_HASKELL_NONINTERACTIVE=1 BOOTSTRAP_HASKELL_INSTALL_STACK=0 BOOTSTRAP_HASKELL_INSTALL_HLS=0 sh && (grep -q ghcup ~/.bashrc || echo '. ~/.ghcup/env' >> ~/.bashrc) && pdm install
